title: Rigorous dyadic rebasing for shared-generator affine interval matrices
problem: Validated parameter-affine transport is operationally bounded on eight-panel factors, but exact rational center and linear coefficients acquire approximately 968 bits per panel. A 64-panel 8x8 carrier remained in exact affine multiplication after 651.5 CPU seconds, while an independent rational skeleton measured about 0.50 seconds for 8 panels, 1.85 seconds for 16, 8.30 seconds for 32 and 46.6 seconds for 64. Joining exact microfactors without rebasing would recreate the same denominator-growth bottleneck.

requested_capability.api: ivam_rebase_dyadic(a: borrow IvAffineMat, bits: i64) -> IvAffineResult
semantics: preserve matrix shape, affine generator and the single shared parameter epsilon
round each exact rational center and linear coefficient to an exact dyadic with the declared bit budget
add an outward interval enclosure of (center-center_dyadic)+(linear-linear_dyadic)*[-1,1] to the existing remainder
return an enclosure containing every value represented by the input affine matrix on the same cell
fail closed on a nonpositive bit budget, nonfinite remainder endpoint, reversed interval, shape defect or unsupported generator
do not collapse the shared affine parameter into independent entrywise interval boxes
phase3_usage: rebase every four to eight panels during local accumulation
use an ordered or balanced composition tree with rebasing after each join
retain exact pre-rebase and post-rebase hashes and a maximum added-remainder ledger

acceptance_tests: C/native parity for exact dyadic inputs, non-dyadic rational inputs and matrices with pre-existing remainders
independent endpoint containment over epsilon=-1,0,1 and randomized rational epsilon values
monotonic containment under repeated rebasing and composition
generator, center and linear correlation are retained rather than flattened
mutations that omit center error, omit linear error, use inward rounding, change the generator or reverse a remainder endpoint are rejected
Phase-3 benchmark: one complete eight-panel 8x8 carrier handoff is emitted and verified, and a multi-factor join does not show unbounded rational bit growth
does_not_establish: that any chosen dyadic bit budget will close the Phase-3 transport
a scattering, flux-signature, CPT, stability or unitarity theorem
